parameters.text:
=📖 **5 WHYS RCA BOT - HELP**

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

**🚀 COMMANDS:**

`/start5whys [ticket]` - Start new RCA session
`/status` - Check current session status
`/ready[N]` - Mark WHY #N data as ready
`/cancel` - Cancel current session
`/help` - Show this help

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

**📋 WORKFLOW:**

1️⃣ Start: `/start5whys RCA-NOV-001`
2️⃣ Provide problem statement
3️⃣ For each WHY (1-5):
   • Read AI question
   • Gather data
   • Fill Google Sheet
   • Reply `/ready[N]`
4️⃣ Get final root cause analysis

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

**💡 TIPS:**

• Be specific with problem statements
• Include metrics and numbers
• Gather actual data, not assumptions
• Fill all 3 columns (Initial, Data, Validated)
• Sessions timeout after 1 hour of inactivity

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

**📊 GOOGLE SHEET:**
[Open Sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/{{ $env.GOOGLE_SHEET_ID }})
